question: What is the building permit process in Vallentuna, step by step? When can I actually start building, and how long does the kommun take to decide?
key_points: The application (with all required documents) is sent through the kommun's e-service or form; an incomplete application is put on hold until it is completed
The bygglov team reviews it, may consult neighbours (sakägare), and the miljö- och samhällsbyggnadsnämnd decides complicated cases
The decision is published in Post- och Inrikes Tidningar and only takes effect four weeks after publication (appeal period)
Building may only start after a startbesked (after a tekniskt samråd for larger projects); starting earlier can lead to a byggsanktionsavgift
A slutbesked is needed before the building may be used
The nämnd must decide within ten weeks of a complete application (PBL 9 kap. 99 §)

question: I own land in Vallentuna that is not zoned for housing. What is the process to change the zoning so I can build homes there, how long does it take and what does it cost?
key_points: The first step is a written request for a planbesked, with a description of the project, a map of the area and the character and approximate size of the buildings (PBL 5 kap. 3 §)
The kommun normally answers within four months of a complete request (PBL 5 kap. 4 §), saying whether it will start a detaljplan and when it expects to adopt it
A planbesked is not binding and cannot be appealed
Vallentuna charges a fee for the planbesked under its PBL taxa (at least 200 mPBB); the detaljplan itself is a separate, longer process
The översiktsplan (Vallentuna 2040) guides whether the kommun will want to plan the area

question: Where can I look up the zoning and the rules that apply to a property in Vallentuna, and which map do I need for a building permit application?
key_points: The kommun's online maps (kommunkarta, tomtkarta) show detaljplaner, property boundaries and designations; you can search by address or property designation
The 'karta för byggplaneringsstöd' shows restrictions, regulations and riksintressen that affect what may be built on a property
A bygglov for a new main building needs a nybyggnadskarta A (B or C for smaller works); a tomtkarta is enough for a förhandsbesked or simple measures
The översiktsplan (non-binding) shows the kommun's long-term intentions; binding rules are in the detaljplan

question: We would like to get a new detaljplan for about 12 homes on Gotland. How does Region Gotland handle such requests, and how quickly would our plan be worked on?
key_points: A project that needs a new detaljplan starts with a planbesked application, which tells whether the project is suitable given the översiktsplan and public interests
Region Gotland has a plan queue and a prioritisation model (adopted 2022, revised December 2025) that decides the order in which plans are worked on
Plans enabling at least 10 homes in areas with a high share of permanent residents get priority 1; fewer than 10 homes there get priority 2
Projects in areas with a low share of permanent residents get priority 3 and may be proposed for refusal, as may requests contrary to the översiktsplan
The kommun must give its planbesked within four months (PBL 5 kap. 4 §), but the plan work itself starts only when the case reaches the front of the queue

question: We are about 15 households who want to build a small eco-village (15-25 homes, shared gardens and workshop) somewhere in Vallentuna kommun, ideally close to public transport. Where in the kommun could this realistically be built, and what would the route to approval be?
key_points: The översiktsplan concentrates development to Vallentuna tätort, Lindholmen, Frösunda, Ekskogen, Kårsta, Gillinge, Karby/Brottby and Löt

Kårsta and Ekskogen are to grow as small-scale, nature-close station villages: new homes next to existing buildings within walking distance of the Roslagsbanan stations (småhus, radhus, low apartment blocks)
Outside the tätorter, a group of homes built together requires a detaljplan; only small additions next to existing buildings are allowed without one
Site choice must consider productive farmland (brukningsvärd jordbruksmark), riksintressen for cultural heritage, and the possibility of water and sewage
The route is a planbesked request to the kommun (answer within four months), then a detaljplan

question: Our group (10-15 households) wants to start a co-housing community with a few small workshops in Norrtälje kommun, ideally near a lake. Which parts of the kommun should we look at, and what would we need to get approval?
key_points: The översiktsplan structure: Norrtälje stad is the main town, Rimbo and Hallstavik are kommundelscentrum, Älmsta and Bergshamra are landsbygdsnoder, where varied housing is to be developed

Building near a lake is limited by strandskydd; LIS areas (landsbygdsutveckling i strandnära lägen) are mainly considered in the northern and western parts, not along the coast or where building pressure is high
A new group of homes needs a detaljplan, starting with a planbesked request
Water and sewage must be solved: connection to the municipal network where available, otherwise a shared solution

question: I'm a developer interested in building a group of about 20 small houses in Uppsala kommun outside the city itself. Where does the kommun want this kind of growth, and what limits apply in the countryside?
key_points: New housing outside the city should mainly go to the prioritised towns (prioriterade tätorter) that have capacity in water and sewage; Gunsta and Storvreta (with Jälla) grow the most

In the countryside, new homes are mainly allowed as additions to existing clusters or as a complement to rural businesses (landsbygdsnäring), not as new extensions of built-up areas in some landscapes
A group of eight or more plots is sammanhållen bebyggelse, and a new group of 20 houses needs a detaljplan (PBL 4 kap. 2 §)
Locations are assessed against water, sewage, traffic, landscape and natural and cultural values (PBL 2 kap.)

question: We have an idea for a regenerative eco-village near Kårsta in Vallentuna: about 20 tiny houses, a shared greenhouse and a composting toilet system, on a few hectares of farmland we could buy. The land is outside any detaljplan. What are we missing, and how could we make this work?
key_points: Obstacle: a group of 20 houses is new sammanhållen bebyggelse and needs a detaljplan (PBL 4 kap. 2 §); single bygglov or förhandsbesked cannot be used for it
Obstacle: building on productive farmland (brukningsvärd jordbruksmark) is only allowed for essential public interests when no other land is suitable (MB 3 kap. 4 §)
Lever: start with a planbesked request; the ÖP wants Kårsta to grow as a small station village next to existing buildings near the station, which supports a well-placed site
Lever: organise shared facilities (sewage, roads, greenhouse) as a gemensamhetsanläggning under the anläggningslag; a sewage system needs a permit or notification to the kommun (FMH 13 §)
Ask: where exactly the plot is relative to the station and existing buildings, whether the land is actively farmed, and how water supply would be solved

question: We run a small farm on Gotland outside any village and want to add six guest cabins for farm stays, with a shared well and one shared wastewater system. Can you help us think this through: what would block it and what options do we have?
key_points: Obstacle: Gotland's groundwater is scarce and vulnerable (thin soils, fissured limestone, relict salt water), so the water supply and wastewater solution decide the case; wells must not be drilled too deep
Lever: Region Gotland prefers, after the public network, shared water and sewage solutions run by a samfällighetsförening under a gemensamhetsanläggning, before individual ones

Obstacle: a wastewater system with WC needs a permit from the miljö- och byggnämnd (FMH 13 §), which should be applied for after the bygglov; Gotland's guidelines set treatment requirements that vary by area
Lever: cabins for an existing farm business are assessed by bygglov / förhandsbesked outside a detaljplan; a förhandsbesked can settle the location first
Ask: where the farm is (coast, protection level for wastewater), how many people at most, and whether the cabins are part of the farm business

question: I farm land in the countryside of Uppsala kommun and would like to build three or four houses for farm workers and family members, and maybe sell a couple of plots later. What do I need to think about, and what is the best way to go about it?
key_points: Lever: Uppsala's ÖP allows new homes in the countryside as a complement to a rural business (landsbygdsnäring) when needed to run or develop it
Obstacle: otherwise new homes are mostly limited to small additions to existing clusters; eight or more plots together form sammanhållen bebyggelse, and a new group would need a detaljplan
Lever: a förhandsbesked can confirm that the location is acceptable before paying for a full bygglov application (PBL 9 kap. 74 §)
Obstacle: building on productive farmland is restricted (MB 3 kap. 4 §); the location is assessed against water, sewage, traffic and landscape
Ask: whether the houses are needed for the farm business, how close they are to existing buildings, and whether plots would be split off later (fastighetsbildning)
